target_customer: Brazilian real estate agencies and brokers, with revenue from service providers such as insurers that agencies route renters to
problem: Renting a property in Brazil involves paperwork: background checks, document collection, signatures and insurance. Alude automates this for agencies for free.
business_model: Free software for brokers; revenue from financial and home products sold to renters and owners (insurance and similar)

founders.name: Jota Junior
founders.background_notes: No background on the YC page or the articles opened.

founders.name: Alexandre Dubugras
founders.background_notes: Named as third co-founder and CEO in Contxto and Startupi (Sept 2020); not listed on the YC page. A database says all three were at Smartlike (unverified).

investors: Founders of Stone, Plaid, Brex, Viva Real, Wildlife Studios, Gympass and Ingresse

technical_complexity.rationale: Workflow software integrating background checks, e-signatures and insurance quoting; standard engineering with partner integrations.

defensibility.rationale: Agencies could adopt rival CRMs or portals; the free model and owner database gave some pull.

incumbents: Brazilian real estate portals and CRM vendors
takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found showing an incumbent copied it; the company is still listed active.

market_need_then: Rental paperwork in Brazil is slow and manual; Startupi (Sept 2020) reports about 150 brokers on the platform and 150 on a waitlist, and a goal of 20,000 rentals in 2021.

branding.domain_note: Uses alude.com.br, a Brazil country domain.

identity.voice_and_tone: Short and benefit focused Portuguese header copy addressing the agency

branding.community_and_virality: None found; a few customer complaints on Reclame Aqui.

brand_strength.rationale: Known in Brazilian proptech press at its seed round; little brand-specific coverage.

outcome_analysis: Alude raised a 3.3 million dollar seed in September 2020 with Ribbit Capital and others and is still listed active. Its free-to-broker model monetized through partner products. No later round, acquisition or shutdown was found, so its trajectory after the seed is unclear.
notes: Seed confirmed by Contxto, Startupi and LAVCA. CB Insights labels it a Series A and lists about 3.45M over two rounds; Latka calls the company bootstrapped with 1.2M revenue in 2024 (unverified, conflicts). Competitor search and both 2020 articles name no rivals, and aggregator lists were undated, so the list is empty. Company site fetch returned only a header.
